proposed_widenings.name: modify_spell_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: Innate Sorcery raises the caster's spell save DC by 1. The spell save DC is a static numeric threshold (8 + PB + spellcasting modifier), not a roll. modify_roll_numeric applies to dice rolls, not to static DC values. modify_ac is the structural parallel for a static defense threshold; there is no offensive equivalent in v4. A new atom is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect — modify_roll_advantage variant
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom modify_roll_advantage exists and is used in the mastery tracer (Sap). However ClassFeatureEffect only admits GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. A new variant is needed to express advantage on spell attack rolls. Note this also exposes a class-scope filter requirement (Sorcerer spell attacks only, not all attack rolls).
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics — duration field
proposed_widenings.justification: Innate Sorcery grants its benefits for 1 minute after activation. ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has no duration field; all encoded class features so far are instant or permanent. The lifecycle atoms persist and expire exist in v4 but are not wired into the class feature schema or tracer.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which you gain the following benefits

notes: Kind (class_feature) and family (activation) exist. activationCost=bonus_action, resource=use_count(fixed:2), resetCadence=long_rest all encode cleanly. Three gaps block encoding: (1) no v4 atom for modifying the spell save DC — the dominant atom_widening gap; (2) ClassFeatureEffect lacks a modify_roll_advantage variant; (3) ClassFeatureActivationMechanics lacks a duration field for the 1-minute window. No Dhall or JSON authored.
